name: Piracetam
reviewed_by: William Gregory M. Rivero, MD, FPCP, DPSN
drafted_by: AI-assisted draft (Claude) for review by Dr. W. Rivero

usual_adult_dose.dose: Start 7.2 g/day, increase by 4.8 g/day every 3 to 4 days to a maximum of 24 g/day in 2 or 3 doses; taper by 1.2 g every 2 days when stopping

key_interactions.effect: Piracetam lowers platelet aggregation, fibrinogen and von Willebrand factor.
key_interactions.action: Use with caution; watch for bleeding.

contraindications: Hypersensitivity to piracetam or other pyrrolidone derivatives
monitoring: Creatinine clearance in older adults and long-term use

sources.citation: College ter Beoordeling van Geneesmiddelen (Medicines Evaluation Board, Netherlands). (n.d.; c. 2010). Piracetam: Proposed core safety profile, sections 4.2–4.9 [Harmonization document]. Retrieved November 17, 2026.
